rv.q: Being a millennial, she is on a journey; in this case, to find bravery, imagination and love (and ideally a dance certificate). This she will achieve only by winning a good-versus-evil battle with Queenie of Hearts (an ebullient Louise McCarthy, the closest this panto has to a dame).
